Nora (Marketing): Quick sync 1: Lumina case study + 30s clip for APAC/EMEA. Need logo + quote approvals, a 15s ad cut, and lead routing to HubSpot by end of week.
Diego (Growth): Promo target: 2026-09-10 promo, webinar 2026-09-22. UTM template: utm_campaign=lumina_case_q3. Will route leads to SFDC campaign + HubSpot 5-day nurture.
Zoe (CS): Customer sent a quote but included a support ticket ID and a cluster name. I asked them to approve a publication-friendly variant and tick logo consent. DocuSign sent.
Marta (Legal): We cant publish support IDs or internal infra names. Request removal or explicit ok from the customer. Also need approval to use the company logo in marketing materials.
Nora (Marketing): Creative brief: 4s brand intro, 21s quote highlight, 5s CTA. Deliverables: 30s master, 15s ad cut, 6s bumper. Subtitles burned EN + ZH. Lower-third: "Lumina  Head of Platform, Aya Suzuki" (subject to CS anonymization).
Diego (Growth): FlowBot, please create draft SFDC campaign "Lumina_Case_Q3_2026" and HubSpot workflow "Lumina_Nurture_5d".
FlowBot: Draft campaign created: "Lumina_Case_Q3_2026". HubSpot workflow placeholder: "Lumina_Nurture_5d". Use /flow finalize to activate.
Zoe (CS): DocuSign returned signed with logo consent; customer asked to replace exact p99 ms with a percentage. Provided sanitized quote and okayed lower-third as "Head of Platform".
Marta (Legal): Approved language: replace numeric p99 with "~30% improvement in 99th percentile latency". No PII in current quote. :thumbsup:
Nora (Marketing): Great. Please paste final quote here once uploaded. Also confirm CDN path and render specs.
Zoe (CS): Final quote: "After moving to Redwood Dedicated we reduced inference spend by ~35% and saw ~30% improvement in 99th percentile latency  Aya Suzuki, Head of Platform, Lumina."
Marta (Legal): Approved. Good to publish under embargo.
Diego (Growth): Budget owner growth@redwood.com. Boost window 9/109/17. I'll attach audience targets when assets export.
Nora (Marketing): FlowBot, run pre-publish checklist when assets are uploaded: render master, export 30/15/6, burned subs en/zh, CDN upload s3://redwood-marketing/lumina/, SFDC finalize, HubSpot activate, blog schedule, social copy prepare, set embargo 2026-09-10T09:00:00Z.
FlowBot: Pre-publish checklist queued. Items: lumina_master.mov, lumina_30s.mp4, lumina_15s.mp4, lumina_6s.mp4, en.srt, zh.srt, s3://redwood-marketing/lumina/, SFDC Lumina_Case_Q3_2026, HubSpot Lumina_Nurture_5d, blog /content/case-studies/lumina.
Nora (Marketing): Scheduling final review 2026-09-10 08:00Z UTC. Everyone please mark calendar.
